ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) regions occupy the lateral quadrants of both lobes. The left lobe contains a vertical white band containing dark internal striations. The right lobe exhibits a distal white region with complex, high-contrast dark linear overlays and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated pixel angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel amplitude of peaks and valleys is most pronounced on the outer thirds of each lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, circular light-colored clusters (approximately 5-10 units) located in the dark central region and on the distal white patch of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel dark linear marks (rake marks) cutting through pigmented areas on both lobes; the right lobe shows a dense, multi-directional network of these features.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring is the dominant acquired feature, particularly dense on the distal regions of both lobes, consistent with inter-species interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: The pattern of rake marks on the outer right lobe creates a highly distinctive, geometric 'circuit-board' visual texture.
